name: សាកស្រឡាញ់បានទេ?​ ​ | Hello Love!​
original_name: សាកស្រឡាញ់បានទេ?​ ​ | Hello Love!​
overview: It is a BL-genre story that talks about a group of students who are assigned to carry out a mission to find ways to get people in Cambodia to regain interest in, and place greater value on, rice farming, rice production, and the country’s tourist destinations.
